description: NaHoP₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.59 Å. Ho is bonded to six O atoms to form HoO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ho-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.27 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent HoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent HoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-57°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.60 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Ho and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ho, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂HoP trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ho, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ho and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ho, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ho, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms.
